title: Balanced Binary Tree
summary: Return whether every node has left and right subtree heights that differ by at most one.
statement: Return whether every node has left and right subtree heights that differ by at most one. An empty subtree has height zero. An empty tree is balanced.

examples.explanation: The only one-sided child adds a difference of one.
The root's left subtree has height two and its right side is empty.
No node can violate the rule.

hints: Conceptual: A tree can fail the rule below a root whose own heights look fine.
Directional: Visit children before their parents so each parent can use computed heights.
Implementation: Reject any node with a height difference above one. Otherwise record one plus the larger child height.
complexityAnalysis: O(n) time. An iterative postorder with stored heights uses O(n) auxiliary space.
